items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: Because it takes a lot of money to do what J.B. Dyas, that now runs the Institute, wants to do.

ctx.x: And that Carl Nosse retired as dean and then started the idea of the Institute and the archives. And it’s all just developing. And hopefully it will get the sponsorship. Because it takes a lot of money to do what J.B. Dyas, that now runs the Institute, wants to do.
